AccessToken.description: Access token of the client application.

Client.description: Name and version of the client application.

Limitation.description: Limitation on the quantity of data returned and optional Cursor for the starting point of data.

EnterpriseIds.description: Unique identifiers of the Enterprises. If not specified, the operation returns data for all enterprises within scope of the Access Token.

ServiceIds.description: Unique identifiers of the [Services](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/services/#service). If not provided, all bookable services are used.

AccountIds.description: Unique identifiers of accounts (currently only [Customers](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/customers/#customer), in the future also [Companies](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/companies/#company)) the reservation is associated with.

PartnerCompanyIds.description: Unique identifiers of the `Companies` on behalf of which the reservations were made.

TravelAgencyIds.description: Identifier of the Travel Agencies (`Company`) that mediated the reservations.

ChannelNumbers.description: Numbers or references used by a Channel (OTA, GDS, CRS, etc.) in case the reservation group originates there, e.g. Booking.com confirmation numbers.

AssignedResourceIds.description: Unique identifiers of the [Resources](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/resources#resource) assigned to the reservations.

AvailabilityBlockIds.description: Unique identifiers of the `Availability blocks` assigned to the reservations.

CreatedUtc.title: Time interval
CreatedUtc.description: Interval in which the [Reservation](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/reservations/#reservation-ver-2023-06-06) was created.

UpdatedUtc.title: Time interval
UpdatedUtc.description: Interval in which the `Reservations` were updated.

CollidingUtc.title: Time interval
CollidingUtc.description: Interval in which the reservations are active. This is defined for a `Reservation` as the period between the reservation's scheduled start time `ScheduledStartUtc` and its scheduled end time `EndUtc`. Reservation is selected if any part of its interval intersects with the interval specified in `CollidingUtc

ScheduledStartUtc.title: Time interval
ScheduledStartUtc.description: Interval filtering Reservations by their scheduled start time. Cannot be used with `ActualStartUtc`.

ActualStartUtc.title: Time interval
ActualStartUtc.description: Interval filtering Reservations by their actual start (check-in) time. Cannot be used with `ScheduledStartUtc`. Note that the filter applies only to started or processed reservations.

ActualEndUtc.title: Time interval
ActualEndUtc.description: Interval filtering Reservations by their actual end (check-out) time. Cannot be used with `ScheduledEndUtc`.

ScheduledEndUtc.title: Time interval
ScheduledEndUtc.description: Interval filtering Reservations by their scheduled end time. Cannot be used with `ActualEndUtc`.

States.description: A list of service order states to filter by.
